summary: This page covers encoder-decoder architectures for graphs, specifically Graph UNet and NED-VAE, for tasks like graph super-resolution and generation. It distinguishes between supervised generation with ground-truth targets and unsupervised learning of graph distributions. The page details evaluation metrics for generative models, including statistical measures like KL divergence and MMD, and topological measures like eigenvector centrality.
